data.title: Take-Two says GTA VI posts record $3.79B in day-one sales
data.description:
Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, setting a record for the biggest entertainment launch across any medium, parent company Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) said on Friday.

Take-Two (TTWO) said the game sold 32.5 million units before its official release, setting a record across all platforms. It also claimed a Metacritic score of 99, describing the critical response as widespread acclaim.

The sales figures are based on company estimates through the end of November 19 worldwide, according to the announcement issued by Rockstar Games.

“It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI,” Sam Houser, president and founder of Rockstar Games, said in a statement.

Houser thanked players worldwide for their response to the release and said the company was excited to share the moment with them.

The game is available through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store, and retailers and storefronts worldwide, the company said.

Grand Theft Auto VI carries an M rating for mature audiences from the Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB).

Shares were trading about 5% higher on Friday.

data.title: Microsoft emphasizes 'pay-for-performance' in its Azure cloud division: report
data.description:
Microsoft (MSFT) management is emphasizing "pay-for-performance" initiatives for employees in its lucrative Azure cloud business, according to Bloomberg.

Employees who demonstrate better performance will receive more benefits, such as additional stock awards, while those with lower performance results will receive higher scrutiny, according to the report, which cited an internal memo.

"Pay-for-performance only works if we are equally rigorous on both sides: recognizing exceptional impact and being honest when performance falls short," said the memo, which was issued by Arun Ulagaratchagan, executive vice president of Azure. 

"Meeting today's bar means closing previous performance gaps and demonstrating a meaningful step-change in impact," he added. "AI is reshaping how the world works, and competition has never been more intense."

"A world-class team like Azure requires world-class talent," a Microsoft spokesperson said, according to the report. "Yesterday, we shared an update to our compensation model in Azure, which includes meaningful additional awards for our strongest performing colleagues. We also shared an update on how we will ensure employees have clear expectations and receive timely, direct feedback from their managers."

Microsoft has focused recently on making the company, which employs more than 220,000 people worldwide, leaner and operate more efficienctly.

Last month, the company began offering a voluntary exit program to eligible employees in the U.S., Canada, India, and the U.K. The buyout program applies to about 60,000 employees. What's more, Azure President Girish Bablani asked senior leaders in his unit to identify ways to reduce costs by at least 20%.

Earlier this year, the company also offered voluntary buyouts to about 7% of its U.S. workforce, or roughly 9,000 employees. Microsoft cut about 4,800 jobs in July, or roughly 2.1% of its global workforce.

data.title: IREN Limited drops 16% amid broad technology selloff

data.title: Eastman Chemical cut to Sell equivalent, Celanese maintained Overweight at J.P. Morgan
data.description:
Eastman Chemicals (EMN) fell 3.3% in Friday's trading as J.P. Morgan downgraded shares to Underweight from Neutral with a $62 price target, trimmed from $65, saying the company's larger markets are not growing and its spreads are under pressure.

Global auto production is declining, the domestic housing market is battling high interest rates, and Eastman's (EMN) commodity businesses are experiencing narrowed spreads in propane and propylene, JPM analyst Jeffrey Zekauskas said, adding that he believes it will be difficult for the company to keep up with the market under those conditions.

The company currently delivers a 7% free cash flow yield and offers a substantial 5.44% dividend yield, and the analyst expects Eastman (EMN) to generate a 6%-7% free cash flow yield for 2027.

Zekauskas maintained an Overweight rating on Celanese (CE), which would throw off a 9% free cash flow yield at his $79 PT and trade on a consolidated basis at 7.5x-8.5x EBITDA consistent with the company's historical trading multiples.
